goal: Freshly lock L0 authority and ownership, then preserve every exact local-only or otherwise preservation-required Local Workspace source selected from the reviewed Inventory v2 before any cleanup, relocation, root binding, remote mutation, or source mutation.

preservation_selector.rule: Select each workspace_entries row only when requires_preservation is true and ownership_status is PROJECT_OWNED or PROJECT_ARTIFACT. Include all 98 reviewed source boundaries, including nested external artifacts, dirty workspaces, the main checkout, two local-only HEAD workspaces, and four synthetic bare repositories. Add the four exact main-checkout tracked modifications from main_checkout.tracked_modifications, cross-checked against the reviewed Blocker Resolution. The source boundaries retain potentially staged, untracked, or ignored content for exact byte resolution during Native PRE. A role marked ROLE_UNRESOLVED never qualifies by role alone. Exclude unrelated and ownership-unresolved rows. No source boundary is authority to copy unreviewed bytes or mutate a source.
preservation_selector.ordering: Ascending case-folded normalized Windows source path with forward slashes, then ref identity, then item classification.

l0_authority_and_ownership_lock: Future Native PRE must freshly verify repository, project, context, current remote main, STATE 25/AUTHORIZED/SYNCED and next_action, immutable Phase G Freeze, exact materialized Design and Plan blobs, reviewed Inventory v2 and Blocker Resolution identities, and applicable Guardrails.

Future Native PRE must map the local topology and registered worktrees relevant to every selected source and prove positive ownership of each source before any preservation copy. Any authority drift affecting a selected item stops that item for reconciliation.

The three ownership-unresolved entries and two proven unrelated repository entries remain outside mutation scope. Fifty-six unresolved worktree roles confer no movement, recreation, deletion, or independent preservation authority.
l1_preservation_boundary: A separately bound EXECUTION_INSTRUCTION and independent LOCAL_WORKSPACE_CONSOLIDATION_L1_NATIVE_PRE PASS are required before any L1 preservation write. This Work Unit grants scope authority only; implementation has not started.

Future execution may create only reviewed preservation copies, Git bundles, and manifests outside the repository under a separately PRE-approved exact destination. Sources remain intact throughout L1. Preserve before any later cleanup.

For each selected source boundary, Native PRE resolves exact required bytes, object identities, dependencies, overlaps and secret indicators. Nested source boundaries must not cause blind recursive copying or double-counting. In particular, the main checkout boundary retains ignored/untracked review coverage while its four unique tracked files are separately identified.

For two local-only target HEADs, Native PRE selects an exact independently restorable repository-external Git bundle or equivalent non-remote artifact; object presence in a worktree alone is insufficient. Preserve associated uncommitted, untracked, staged, or ignored content where reviewed as required.
Four synthetic bare repositories retain exact refs and necessary objects as test evidence, without treating their commits as target-repository remote history.

No L2-L8 execution, D:/w binding, permanent WORKTREE_ROOT creation, worktree move/recreation/prune/repair, dirty main checkout switch/reset/clean/stash, deletion, remote ref mutation, push, source/test/schema/docs/release/Plugin change, STATE change, Local Workspace Freeze, Post-P2 Foundation, or Framework 2.8.0 release is authorized.
preservation_integrity: For every preservation item record exact source identity, positive ownership, reviewed classification, source bytes or Git object identity, exact PRE-approved destination, preservation artifact identity, SHA-256 and/or Git object identity, independent readability or restoration verification, unchanged source verification, and rollback/source-retention statement.
For a Git commit or ref record exact SHA, all required objects, independent commit resolution and readability from the preservation artifact, and unchanged source ref/worktree.
For files verify byte-level identity. For directories and bare repositories use a deterministic content/ref inventory with integrity evidence appropriate to every required byte and object.
If credential or secret indicators are detected, do not copy that item into an unsafe or general archive; return SECRET_HANDLING_REVIEW_REQUIRED and stop that item fail-closed.

completion_boundary.l1_pass_meaning: Only independently reviewed preservation of the selected exact content; Local Workspace Consolidation remains incomplete.
